summary: The PR resolves the issue with `minversion` by replacing `LooseVersion` with `parse_version`, which handles version strings more robustly. The added scripts help demonstrate the fix.

issues.description: The new scripts (`reproduce_error.py`, `reproduce_error_2.py`, `test_edge_cases.py`) are added but not part of the test suite. They should either be integrated into the test suite or removed if they are not meant to be part of the repository.
